posts.title: Rose
posts.description: Our gardening successes are almost entirely down to pure luck, rather than any sort of skill or judgement. This rose is one example of a plant that chose to grow in spite of our meddling.

posts.title: Aikido Seiryukan Spring Seminar
posts.description: This weekend just passed, our aikido club hosted a two-day seminar featuring Atsushi Mimuro Shihan, plus his wife Cathy and some of his students from Yokohama. We had a whole bunch of other guests as well, from Australia and around New Zealand. It was a fantastic weekend.
